patches.name: Stellarium Extended Catalog
patches.description: Import a locally downloaded extended catalog ZIP instead of waiting for a Play Asset Delivery download that a sideloaded install can never receive. Nothing is downloaded and nothing is requested at launch; without a ZIP the app is unchanged. Enabled by default; turn it off in Expert mode if you do not want the ZIP entry.

patches.name: Stellarium Extended Catalog (ZIP support)
patches.description: Adds the "open with" and share-sheet entries that let Stellarium receive a locally downloaded extended catalog ZIP. Used by Stellarium Extended Catalog.

patches.name: Stellarium Premium
patches.description: Unlock Stellarium Plus by patching the native license checks, and skip the Play data pack request a sideloaded install cannot satisfy (arm64-v8a and armeabi-v7a).

repoDescription: Repo for creating and releasing custom Morphe patches
